strategies.text: Mind-control caster; keep a CC breaker and kill her quickly so the controlled player is not lost.
Frost-based caster; keep the group together and dispel his debuffs.
Hits hard and rages; tank him at the corridor end so the cleave only hits the tank.
Surrounded by ghouls in Slaughter Square; clear them first.
Summons skeletons and a death-knight style mount; use defensive cooldowns and kill the adds.
